fluff.overview:
The Trebaruna is a ninety-five ton quad assault BattleMech whose origins trace back to the Word of Blake Protectorate. Plans for the design were discovered in Blakist databases seized during the Coalition assault on Terra, with partially decrypted information suggesting the 'Mech was developed from stolen Free Rasalhague Republic drafts. The Blakists had planned to begin production in 3078, but scrapped the project as Coalition forces closed the noose around Terra. Though much of the captured data was available to all Coalition partners, only three nations elected to put the Trebaruna into production. The Republic of the Sphere fielded the design first in 3081, followed closely by the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth and the Capellan Confederation.

Named for an ancient goddess of battle, protection, and death, the Trebaruna serves as a resilient long-range fire support platform. Its unusual quad chassis configuration provides exceptional stability for its heavy armament, and the design has earned a reputation as a durable command vehicle capable of anchoring defensive positions.
fluff.capabilities:
The Trebaruna is an incredibly resilient design. Sixteen tons of Durallex Heavy armor protect the Pitban 285 standard fusion engine at its heart. Forgoing an extralight engine saves precious space in the cramped confines of the quadruped chassis and provides excellent survivability in the event of side torso destruction. Where many modern assault machines are rendered functional kills after losing a side torso, the Trebaruna is barely slowed.

Firepower is modest for an assault-class machine but carefully selected for sustained engagement. The Imperator Dragon's Fire Gauss rifle serves as the primary weapon, a reliable and low-maintenance system with a solid record on the Atlas and Orion. Two tons of ammunition stored in a rapid-feed magazine below the breach keep the weapon firing, while CASE protection mitigates the risk of a catastrophic ammunition explosion. Backing up the main gun is a trio of Moscovia light particle projection cannons, providing consistent energy-based firepower at range.

An Orion Suretrak XVII targeting computer significantly enhances the value of these armaments. Four Chilton 950 improved jump jets give the Trebaruna a 120-meter jump range, a remarkable capability for a ninety-five ton machine. The Hartford JEQ-5 communications system includes all standard features expected in a battalion or regimental command platform.
fluff.history:
The Trebaruna's history begins not with its production, but with its theft. The original design specifications were apparently pilfered from Free Rasalhague Republic military archives, though this claim remains uncorroborated. What is known is that Word of Blake engineers on Terra refined the concept into a production-ready assault quad, intending it as a command platform for Protectorate Militia and Word of Blake Militia formations. When the allied Coalition closed in on Terra in 3078, the Blakists abandoned the Trebaruna project to focus resources on strategic weaponry for their final defense.

Following the liberation of Terra, Coalition intelligence teams discovered the complete production plans in seized Blakist databases. The data was shared among the allied nations, though the Federated Suns, Draconis Combine, and Lyran Commonwealth all chose not to develop the design. The Republic of the Sphere, building its Republic Armed Forces from scratch, was eager for new designs untainted by Succession Wars-era politics and brought the Trebaruna into production at Kressly WarWorks on Epsilon Eridani in 3081. The Marik-Stewart Commonwealth followed suit at Earthwerks-FWL on Keystone, and the Capellan Confederation established production at Ceres Metals Industries on St. Ives.

The Trebaruna has served in all three nations' frontline formations since its introduction. In the Republic Armed Forces, it deployed with the Hastati Sentinels and Principes Guards, where its quad chassis and heavy armor made it a favored command vehicle. The Marik-Stewart Commonwealth produced the TR-XJ variant at Keystone and sold examples to other former Free Worlds League states where relations permitted. House Liao fielded the largest number of TR-XLs in the St. Ives Armored Cavalry, and the design has appeared in the forces of multiple Warrior Houses.

As the Dark Age deepened, the Trebaruna remained in continuous production across all three factory sites. Changes in political ownership affected the Keystone facility, which passed from Marik-Stewart Commonwealth control to Clan Wolf during the ilClan era. The design's proven reliability and straightforward logistics ensured demand remained steady through the turbulent decades following the collapse of the HPG network and the rise of Fortress Republic.
fluff.deployment: Introduced in 3115, this variant is a specialized siege variant built around more than twenty-five tons of hardened armor, enabling it to shrug off withering volumes of enemy fire that would cripple lighter designs. The internal structure uses a composite skeleton to save weight, though this comes at the cost of fragile internal components that are more susceptible to critical damage. The primary armament is an improved heavy Gauss rifle, delivering devastating kinetic impacts at extreme range. A turret-mounted extended-range particle projection cannon provides secondary firepower with a wide field of fire, compensating for the quad chassis's limited torso rotation. Produced at all three factory sites, this variant serves in formations requiring a heavy assault platform capable of absorbing sustained punishment while advancing on fortified positions.
